datasets.name: CalcedDeposits
datasets.sql:
select 
 cont.id,
 cont.contractno,
 sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(acc.ContractAccID)                  as ContractAccNo,
 sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(acc.InterestAccID)                  as InterestAccNo,
 sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccountName(acc.contractaccid)              as custname,
(select sum(facticaldebt) from sbcm_contract_state where id#=cont.id)         as facticaldebt,
(select sum(facticalinterestdebt) from sbcm_contract_state where id#=cont.id) as facticalinterestdebt,
(select sum(interest) from sbcm_deposit_interests where id#=cont.id)          as interest,
 SBCM_Stored_Programs.CheckContractState(cont.ID)                             as  Status,
 av.val_name,
 cont.currency,
 cont.personaltype,
 cont.clienttype,
 cont.customerid,
 cont.branchid
from sbcm_contracts cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts acc,
     avalute av
where cont.type# = 3
and acc.id# = cont.id
and cont.currency = av.valute
and cont.type# = 3
order by :OrderField

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
select id,name from customers
where id in (select customerid from sbcm_contracts
where type# = 3)
